<subject>Invitation to Participate in the Lumière Santé Regional Healthcare Innovation Workshop</subject>
<body>
Dear Dr. Martin,

Please find below a formal invitation to attend, participate, and present at the Lumière Santé Regional Healthcare Innovation Workshop. A printed copy of this invitation will follow shortly.

Dr. Martin  
Lumière Santé SAS  
12 Rue de la Santé  
75014 Paris, France  

Paris, March 12, 2024

I am pleased to invite you to join us as a speaker at the upcoming Lumière Santé Regional Healthcare Innovation Workshop. Each invited presentation will be allocated thirty minutes, followed by approximately ten minutes for discussion. This workshop, supported by a grant from the French Ministry of Health, will differ from typical industry conferences by focusing on the practical applications of healthcare technologies and innovations currently driving progress within hospital groups and medical laboratories. Moreover, the event will highlight the collaborative efforts bridging healthcare providers, research institutions, and governmental bodies.

The workshop will be held at the Hôtel de la Santé in Lyon on April 27-28. We are able to cover travel expenses, accommodation, and meals for all invited speakers, and can assist with travel arrangements if needed.

We sincerely hope you will accept this invitation. Should you agree, please send us your presentation title, a brief abstract, and any technical requirements for your talk.

We look forward to welcoming you to Lyon.

Kind regards,

Sophie Durand  
Lumière Santé SAS  
</body>
